channel.description: Latest articles from EVENTFAQS Media Pvt (eventfaqs.com)

item.title: Shriya Rao to Perform at Depot48 – A Voice Shaped by Vulnerability and Self-Discovery
item.description: Singer-songwriter Shriya Rao will perform at Depot48, New Delhi, on February 27, 2026, marking her first live show in Delhi NCR.

item.title: Anjunadeep Announces Two-City India Return with Open Air Shows in Mumbai and Bengaluru
item.description: Anjunadeep will stage Open Air shows in Mumbai and Bengaluru on March 14 and 15, 2026, marking its latest expansion in India in partnership with Johnnie Walker Blonde Non-Alcoholic Lemonade.

item.title: NR Talent & Event Management Announces Middle East Expansion with NGR Events and Entertainment
item.description: NR Talent & Event Management has expanded into the Middle East as NGR Events and Entertainment, bringing its culturally rooted, music-led live event formats to new audiences while developing region-specific experiences.

item.title: DNPA Conclave 2026 to Address AI’s Impact on News, Monetisation and Policy Frameworks
item.description: DNPA Conclave 2026 will bring together policymakers and media leaders in New Delhi to deliberate on AI, regulation and the future of India’s digital news ecosystem.

item.title: Jaipur Polo Team Partners with Johnnie Walker Luxe Blended Water for 2025–26 Season
item.description: Jaipur Polo Team has partnered with Johnnie Walker Luxe Blended Water for the 2025–26 season, introducing curated hospitality experiences across seven tournaments in India.

item.title: Padel360 Launches First Indoor Padel League in Mumbai with ₹5.5 Lakh Prize Pool
item.description: Padel 360 will host its first indoor franchise padel league in Worli from February 27 to March 1, featuring six teams and a ₹5.5 lakh prize pool.

item.title: The LaLiT New Delhi Appoints Vishal Sharma as General Manager
item.description: The LaLiT New Delhi has appointed hospitality professional Vishal Sharma as General Manager, bringing over 18 years of industry experience to the leadership role.

item.title: H T Parekh Foundation to Host Inaugural Harsha Parekh Librarian Awards in Mumbai
item.description: The H T Parekh Foundation will host the inaugural Harsha Parekh Librarian Awards in Mumbai on February 28, 2026, recognising children’s librarians and library leaders across India.

item.title: Haldiram Snacks Food Pvt. Ltd. Appoints Annu Gupta as CEO – International Business
item.description: Haldiram Snacks Food Pvt. Ltd. has appointed former Britannia executive Annu Gupta as CEO – International Business, marking a new phase in its global expansion plans.

item.title: Government of Uttar Pradesh Signs MoU with AVW Global to Bring Back MotoGP Races and Asia Road Racing Championship
item.description: The Uttar Pradesh government has signed an MoU with AVW Global to revive MotoGP and the Asia Road Racing Championship at Buddh International Circuit, aiming to restore India’s presence on the global racing calendar.
